authoring: Synthetic cases authored before outputs. No real persona content or earlier evaluation outputs are included. Labels are author judgments, not independent human adjudication. Once observed this set is a regression/diagnostic set, never a future untouched holdout. Read-only methodology review corrected sufficient alternative evidence and whole-key query before any answer calls. Initial retrieval-only draft diagnostics were inspected; no answer labels were tuned against model answers.

budget.token_limit_semantics: Stop thresholds between calls with reserved headroom; one in-flight call can overshoot. Hard call cap, 120s worker timeout, 180s poll deadline. No automatic answer retries.

decision_rules.policy: Single synthetic run can justify a bounded follow-up, not population-level rollout. Keep ranking/budgets unless a separately reviewed fresh evaluation meets these floors. Curation requires an owner and revision-protected review; no automatic consolidation.

summary.description: One manually written archive summary; seven redundant pin texts compressed without changing keys/facts. One authoring pass, no output-driven edits.
summary.timing_limit: Retrospective estimate of text authoring/review, not stopwatch telemetry.
